counterfactual_missing_items: No conjunctival injection, rash, oral mucosal changes, extremity changes, or cervical lymphadenopathy to support Kawasaki disease
No evidence of an alternative pathogen or negative M. pneumoniae testing

decisive_items: M. pneumoniae-IgM titer: 1:320, later increased to >1:1280
PCR positive for M. pneumoniae in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
Bilateral diffuse parenchymal infiltration, lobar consolidation in middle and lower right lung lobes and left upper lobe, bilateral pleural effusions
response.rationale: R1 is the only candidate directly tied to the causative organism by two independent raw microbial findings (rising IgM and BAL PCR), and it explains the respiratory examination, imaging, and both bronchoscopic and echocardiographic abnormalities as severe Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia with complications. R2 relies on a single late coronary-artery finding without KD-specific clinical criteria, and R3 is a bronchoscopic complication that lacks etiologic specificity.

rejected.why: Coronary artery dilation alone is insufficient for Kawasaki disease; no conjunctival/oral/extremity/lymph-node criteria are provided, while an etiologic M. pneumoniae infection is confirmed.

Plastic bronchitis is a downstream complication of the confirmed M. pneumoniae infection, not an independent primary diagnosis that explains fever, consolidation, effusions, and serologic/PCR findings.
